src: HAVE A NICE DAY.
It's been salvaged for parts.
It's buzzing. Electricity?
Here's a little plaque.
"Save your data for yourself and the upcoming generations. 5000 years guaranteed."
The insides have been pierced by stalagmites.
Some brown stuff is dripping down constantly.
The leg of a plushie is stuck below.
It's warm, as if used recently.
There's some rotating brushes in here. They have trouble turning though.
What a place to kick the bucket.
You return.
Made any progress recently with your studies?
Not really. Science is oftentimes a slow process.
But I'm persistent. We'll figure this out.
Anything else?
You have any idea where to get a friend for a big meat guy?
Ehh... what?
I met this giant flesh creature. Looked like some tentacle animal.
And it's a bit lonely and asking for a friend.
Fascinating.
What kind of friend would a creature like that need? Another flesh creature?
I don't know. It accepted me as a friend though.
Interesting.
Is that creature dangerous?
I don't know.
Interesting.
Maybe you could repurpose one of the androids for this.
That creature gets a friend, we have a chance to observe, and no one gets endangered.
Where would I get an android for this?
There's no use asking one of the Enforcers.
But I saw a broken android out there in Tauris, near the old house to the south.
Alright. Will take a look. Thanks.
Oh, I think I know which one.
Thanks.
It's that flesh tentacle creature I told you about.
Can you examine me?
Yes, I would be willing to.
This is quite interesting for me, too, you know.
You would be the first case I could study that's still in a very premature state.
Very exciting.
Premature? So you have an idea what this leads to?
No. Don't know at this point. A mutation perhaps.
Ehh... Is there a cure?
I don't think so.
But first things first. I'm not fully equipped to perform human cell study.
I'm gonna need a medical scanner and some octagon fluid.
Maybe you can get a scanner from the doctor here in Tauris. Tell him it's for me. Mortus.
And there's no octagon fluid around here. You'll have to search one of the old facilities to the north.
Last but not least, it would be helpful if you got me some mutant brain tissue.
Alright. I'll take a look.
What did you want me to do?
Walk over to the Flesh Nexus and see if the flesh reacts to you.
What was it you needed from me?
Some brain tissue, some octagon fluid, and a medical scanner.
Alright. Will take a look.
I have all the items you wanted.
Nice. Give them to me.
Good. Let me prepare this.
Alright. I've adjusted the frequency of the scanner to listen to any flesh activity.
Let me see.
Yes. There's definitely some activity.
Not much though.
Would be interesting to see how the Flesh Nexus reacts to your body if it's enhanced by Octagon Fluid.
The Flesh Nexus?
It's my name for the web of flesh that fills these caves.
It has mass, tentacles and nodes.
There's a remarkable node here at the back of this cave.
Here, let me apply some of that Octagon fluid to your skin.
If I am correct, then this should make you a lot more attractive to the Nexus.
Go over to the node and give it a try.
Alright.
Oh. I already talked to that thing.
Interesting. Your mutations must have developed further than suspected.
But more importantly, what did you see? Is it intelligent?
I'm not entirely sure about the Flesh Nexus itself.
But there was someone in there, communicating through the Nexus.
Called himself the Oracle. And he wants me to find him.
Oh. But... How? Why?
I don't know yet.
Fascinating.
The Oracle mentioned a worm shaman.
And that a worm shaman is bound to help the Oracle.
That sounds odd.
A shaman, you say? Maybe like that witch at the old trees?
A witch?
It's what the people call her. I don't really know what's up with her.
Witch. Shaman. Maybe it's the same. Or connected.
I think you should try talking to her.
Alright.
Fascinating. Sounds like a real adventure.
I think you've earned yourself some rest now, though.
I examined the Flesh Nexus...
And?
It reacts to me. I feel like I could communicate with it, even.
Only, my voice is not strong enough, or something like that.
Fascinating.
How would you... how would you get a stronger voice for that?
I don't know. I'll look around.
Maybe I'll find another flesh node or stuff like that.
I don't know, really.
I met this giant flesh creature though. Looked like some tentacle animal.
Maybe this creature might teach me how to get a stronger voice?
Interesting.
Yes. Worth a shot, I guess.
Ok. I'll go talk to it.
Maybe that flesh tentacle creature I told you about.
I've talked to the Flesh Nexus.
You did? Is it... are we talking about an intelligent being here?
About the Oracle...
About the Flesh Nexus...
You wanted to visit that tentacle creature, see if it can teach you how to communicate with the Flesh Nexus.
Ah, right.
I feel ready to talk to the Flesh Nexus now.
Alright. How would you do it?
Don't know how, but I feel like I have a voice now.
Interesting. Please, give it a try.
A visitor.
What are you doing here?
Examining the flesh. The machines. Finding out about our place among them.
But my current studies are mostly focused on the flesh.
I wonder... What's your perception of all the forms of meat around us?
[Stay silent.]
My general observations would be that it's unusual and we cannot discern where it comes from.
Its origin is what I'm concerned about. And its connection to the infections and mutations.
Ehhh... I was cast out from the habitat because I'm contaminated. Could this be related?
Interesting. There are no visible signs of any illness.
How do you feel?
Pretty normal, most of the time. Occasionally sickness overcomes me and I have the urge to vomit.
Alright. Those could be the first signs of your metabolism changing.
It's unusual.
That's a good observation.
I would even say that there's no discernible origin of the meat.
It's free food.
I guess it is.
There's a lot of it.
Correct.
It's just there.
Well, 'just' is a pretty bold assumption.
I am glad that you returned to me.
Are you the companion whom I have awaited so long?
I guess I could be that companion.
Oh, what joy I am feeling.
I did suppress any premature sentiments of hope. I did not dare to yearn too much.
But a trickle remained, I admit, and now I see that it was warranted.
Lead on then and guide me.
I name you companion from now on.
A friendly face in this dark cavern.
My heart blooms, encountering another person, and my mood lightens, for I know that I won't be as alone anymore.
It pains me to see so much coldness in this world.
This piece of journey will be a joy to spend together, won't it?
Onwards, with a sturdy heart.
Dear companion, let us continue on our path.
I can sense a profound warmth that fills the area around us.
This place speaks to me. The open structure, the sun and the trees: They welcome me, don't they?
I can see my mind resting here, and the environment will dispel any quips of boredom, of that I am sure.
So be it then.
I will miss the companionship, but I know that you have to continue with your journey now.
Farewell, my friend.
I feel a sense of dread in this place, dear companion.
A disturbing force at the fringes of my mind, compelling me to dwell here.
It is a form of unrest, but a fulfilling one, and I long for it.
Will this be the place where I will stay, live and abide?
Yes, this is the place.
A dread hangs over me, but I see now that this is where I am supposed to be.
Life is full of challenges, isn't it?
And it is right that we don't flee them, dear companion.
It is beautiful here.
I often think about the quest we took part in together, dear companion.
But I am glad now that we have found a site or rest.
Dear companion, it looks like we have two paths ahead of us.
The path on the right will lead us to a quiet place. Some forlorn site where the heart may rest in eternity.
And I can feel my heart yearning for it.
But there's another feeling, too.
A presence, an "unknowing", an oscillating morsel of unquietness, and it beckons us towards the left.
Oh, I fear for my soul, looking at that dark path ahead. Yet at the same time there's a curious spirit in me, longing to explore it.
Go forward, companion, and I will follow.
EnteringDarkArea
This place fills me with a dark foreboding.
EnteringTranquilArea
Ohhh, look at this peaceful and friendly place.
EnteringCrossroads
We are at a crossroads. Let us contemplate our journey.
Hey, old man.
Hahaha. Look at you. Wearing clothes, so serious and all.
You having a good day?
The best.
Here, look at my dancing skills...
It's how I celebrate the sun.
Now, off you go.
Maybe you're interested in a big, meaty friend?
Ohhh. You mean that big flesh monster in that temple over there?
Nah. Not interested in any relationship with it.
I mean... clothes are very practical.
Uhhh. Like I said, serious.
Hey, I am not interested.
Please leave me alone now.
I'm leaving.
That's good. Privacy is important.
Do you need help with anything?
Nah. I don't need any help.
Oh, nice. A fellow traveler.
People over here are a bit weird though.
I was looking for some food, but they only serve raw meat. Blergh.
Back to eating plants and dirt, I guess.
Ah well, see ya.
Hey, welcome to my humble abode.
I thought this place looked nice.
Maybe I'll begin decorating it.
Buhuhu...
*gulp*
Bwawawaaa...
*gulp*
*hick*
Oh Millja...
*sniff*
Why have you left?
Oh, I'm sho lonely...
Hey, I found somebody for you.
This is bad
I heard that you've been really sad recently.
Let me help you forget all of that.
What do you mean? I don't want to forget Millja...
Oh... Oooohh...
How about this fleshworm?
I know, It's not Millja.
But maybe you just need somebody to take care of.
Oh. It's sho cuuute. Gimme.
Dis is greeeat.
